summary: PureCycle Technologies filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 17,570,200 common shares at $8.21 per share (vs. $10.80 prior close), alongside a concurrent $250M convertible notes offering. Proceeds will partly repurchase ~$216M of existing 7.25% Green Convertible Notes due 2030, including $50M from Sylebra Capital affiliates. The offerings are not conditional on each other or the note repurchases. Underwriters include Morgan Stanley and Cantor. This is a routine equity/debt capital raise with no special-situation catalyst; the only 'event' is the capital structure adjustment via note repurchase. No board recommendation, premium, or change-of-control element.
